high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a tweet from the Twitter account @fusioncoil. The tweet is dated July 15 and has received 756,702 likes. The tweet contains the following text: "Elon Musk just announced that Tesla cars will soon be able to connect to each other via Bluetooth allowing drivers to communicate and speak with other Tesla drivers nearby. Road rage about to be like a Halo Reach Grifball lobby" The tweet includes an image of the interior of a Tesla car, showing the steering wheel, dashboard, and the large touchscreen display. The car appears to be stationary, as there is no motion
